'''First Anthology''' is the 10th expansion of Star Wars CCG.
It is published by Decipher in 1997 and consists of 6 cards.

This set featured six preview cards that, while at the time were unique, were later found in the Special Edition card set. The most popular one, at the time, was the first appearance of Boba Fett.

== Card list ==

These six cards were '''white-bordered previews''' in the First Anthology (May 1997). They are the same cards later printed with black borders in [[Special Edition]], and they became tournament-legal when this product was released. They are listed here and again under Special Edition.
